verdict_reason: A clean rename from OperatorIndexIT, but the test keeps Given/When/Then comments (one describing Spring Data) and proves two behaviours in one method.

todos.issue: index_shouldDeclareOrgStatusCreatedAndUseItInExplainPlan has four Given/When/Then comments (lines 24, 28, 43, 59). Line 24 ('auto-index-creation builds indexes at context startup') describes Spring Data, not the lines below it. The two When/Then pairs show one test proving two behaviours, the declared index set and the planner's choice. The bundle says: 'If you need a second // Then, you have a second test.' This PR renamed the class from OperatorIndexIT, so its comments fall under review.
todos.fix: Must: the file has no Given/When/Then comments, and each test proves one behaviour: the declared index set and fields in one test, the explain plan choosing org_status_created in another. One way: split the method into index_shouldDeclareOnlyOrgStatusCreatedOnOrganisationStatusAndCreatedAt and listQuery_shouldUseOrgStatusCreatedIndex, and delete the four comments.
